time_semantics: timeline date is UTC; the official dynamic Madeira radar page specifies UTC
native_grid: EPSG:4326 pixel centers derived from the bounds passed to Leaflet ImageOverlay
scientific_decode: ordinal categories from the official mm/h legend; no point-rate interpolation
transparent_pixel_semantics: no displayed colored return; below-detection quality, not numeric zero rainfall
opaque_black_semantics: not present in the official legend; decoded as missing
